# Hiring-Manager / Project Chat + AI Philosophy

[← Okta](../README.md) · [Every Okta question](../../okta.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/hm-project-and-ai-philosophy)

`ai-collaboration` `deep-dive` `leadership`

---

## Requirements

Expect one or more conversational sessions with the hiring manager and/or a project lead. Two themes consistently appear:

- **Project / resume deep-dive** — your experience, the projects you drove, and the engineering reasoning behind them. Staff-level candidates should be prepared to dissect the most difficult piece of a previous project and justify the system-design trade-offs they chose.
- **AI philosophy** — your perspective on AI, how it shapes your daily workflow, and how you partner with AI tooling. This surfaces across recent interview loops, not exclusively in the OA.

For senior/Staff candidates the broader discussion also touches on on-call rotations, security/infrastructure incident handling, sprint mechanics, roadmap planning, and org/team design.

## Notes

- The AI discussion carries real weight, not just filler — a candidate who talked about "views on AI and its impact on daily work" with a project lead was still rejected, so come with a specific, opinionated position: where AI truly speeds you up, where you retain the final call, and how you preserve quality while leveraging it.
- These conversations are warm and open-ended; steer with ownership and concrete results instead of waiting for questions.

## Preparation

- Have 2–3 project narratives ready with clear scope, your choices, and measurable outcomes. For the hardest project, sketch the architecture and practice the alternatives you discarded and why.
- Compose a one-paragraph viewpoint on collaborating with AI tools and practice delivering it aloud.
